reason: New test only; adds coverage for multi-range selected-series compaction without altering production code or existing assertions.
headline: New test: selected-series compaction writes one hinted block per range
summary: Adds a test that appends one series with samples from t=100 to t=1400, spanning two 1000ms chunk ranges, then calls CompactSelectedSeries. It asserts the series is evicted, exactly two blocks are written, and each carries the FromSelectedSeries hint. It is test-only, so it cannot change runtime behavior, and the setup is simple enough that a line-by-line review can be skipped.
